input_manifest.selection_rule: One SHA256-ranked candidate absent from both NT24 and NT20 per each of the fixed first200 samples; one shared candidate per32 SHA256-ranked sample controls. Selection made while every broad-NR outcome was pending.
limits: Frozen one-pair-per-sample diagnostic panel, not a read-weighted accuracy estimate.
Original separate trimmed mates, not production mate merging.
Original selection predates broad-NR outcomes; choosing to reuse this panel occurs after those outcomes.
New nucleotide controls match16threads and full19field outputs; older8thread controls retained separately.
Translated search uses word4 threshold18 after the matched43mate pilot; defaultTBLASTX not scaled.
Evalues may change when retrieved HSP sets change; shared bitscore parity does not assert Evalue parity.

method.name: tblastx-word4-one-batch
method.role: Bounded execution-control candidate: keep word4 scoring and full core_nt while concatenating this existing query panel into one batch
limits: Same requested scoring, reference and read set; output parity remains to be measured.
The env wrapper changes only the child process BATCH_SIZE; prior experiment configuration is unchanged.
